//: GLOBAL wiring only. The template already runs its two memory hooks from its own .claude/settings.json for conversations opened in the stack folder; use this file when you want hooks in every folder. Drop this hooks block into your Claude Code settings.json (merge it with whatever else lives there). Copy the reference/ hooks to ~/.claude/hooks/stack/ first, or point the paths wherever you keep them. Every command is a shell invocation; the hook reads its JSON payload from stdin.
// stackUpdateCheck: Config for the update-check SessionStart hook. It reads THIS block from your real settings.json at runtime, falling back to the constants at the top of update-check.js when a key is absent. updateCheck toggles the once-a-day check; templateUpstream is the owner/repo it asks for a version (re-point it if you forked); There is no localVersionFile here on purpose: when the hook runs from inside your stack it finds that stack's STACK_VERSION on its own. Add "localVersionFile": "/absolute/path/to/STACK_VERSION" only if you copied the hooks elsewhere (for example ~/.claude/hooks/stack/); a wrong path makes the hook read v1 and nudge every session. To disable without editing any file, set the env var STACK_UPDATE_CHECK=off.
// memory: Only needed for global wiring: hooks copied out of the stack cannot find it on their own. Set env.LARARIUM_ROOT to one absolute installed-stack path for both memory hooks. They read soul/core.md, soul/heartbeat.md, brain/now.md and handoff.md below it. Merge env keys with your existing settings.
